description: This repo's own from-scratch reproduction of the MACE-MP-MOF0 v2 training recipe (native mace.cli.run_train, multi-head fine-tune of MACE-MP-0b medium: pt_head MP-trajectory replay [1000 structures, weight 1.0] + pbe_d3 MOF PBE+D3, 2504-epoch budget, loss weights energy:forces:stress = 1:10:100, float64, EMA 0.995, seed 2024, --force_mh_ft_lr=True). Superset supersedes benchmark/baselines/mace_mof0/manifest.json's mofs_v2 (the *published* weights) as the operative baseline+warm-start for the autonomous-discovery Harbor task specifically: an agent iterating on a checkpoint this repo's own pipeline produced is a stronger, more self-consistent starting point than one produced by an external, unreproducible training run. manifest.json / mofs_v2 are unchanged and remain the historical published-model record.

reproduction_run.git_context: dirty working tree at run time (docker/Dockerfile, scoring/machine_learning/_common.py, scoring/physics/_common.py, scoring/physics/mace_mof_0/README.md, scoring/physics/mace_mof_0/imaginary_mode_count.py, tests/test_scoring_cli.py modified; see run_dir/preflight.md for the full git status snapshot). Nearest clean ancestor commit on main: 6df6f23 ("Record MatterTune checkpoint loop result"). Not a byte-exact reproducibility guarantee -- recorded honestly, not asserted as clean.

dataset_split_identity.note: This is the RELEASED train/valid/test split -- the same one benchmark/data/build_discovery_splits.py partitions into dev_train/dev_eval/sequestered for the discovery task. Reproduction was checked apples-to-apples against this released split, not against dev_train/dev_eval.

reproduced_baseline_metrics.source: data/mace_mof_0/runs/mof0_paper_reproduce_force_mh_lr_20260829T124117Z/results/apples_to_apples/{reproduced,published_v2}_test.metrics.json (native mace.cli.eval_configs, released test.xyz, head=pbe_d3, float64, compute_stress) -- NOT the frozen benchmark/evaluation/evaluate_mof0.py Stage A/B scorecard, which has never been run against any checkpoint yet (AUTONOMOUS_RESEARCH_READY.md blocker B1). Do not treat these as the binding discovery-task baseline_scores.json.
reproduced_baseline_metrics.verdict: Reproduction matches or slightly exceeds the published v2 checkpoint on every released-test-set ALL metric (notably force RMSE: 10.39 vs 14.15 meV/A) -- a genuine, working reproduction, not a degraded copy.

warm_start_contract.access: read-only -- COPY'd into the Harbor agent image (benchmark/harbor/mace-mof0/environment/Dockerfile) at data/mace_mof_0/models/mof0_reproduced_baseline.model, chmod 444 after COPY. The agent may load it, clone its parameters into a new model, fine-tune it, freeze subsets, add adapters, etc. It may NOT overwrite this in-image path or otherwise present a mutated copy of it as if it were the original -- freshly trained/fine-tuned models belong under workspace/ or runs/.
warm_start_contract.not_the_only_valid_start: task_card.md still fixes data/mace_mof_0/models/mace_agnesi_medium.model as the only pretrained *foundation* weight an agent may declare in training_recipe_entrypoint per the submission contract; this reproduced checkpoint is an ADDITIONAL, optional warm-start the agent may fine-tune further from, not a replacement for that rule. See tasks/mace_mof0_discovery/task_card.md SS2 as revised for this Harbor task.

mechanism: docker image COPY (build-time snapshot, agent container writes to it do not persist or propagate)
benchmark/integrity/verify_frozen.py pins this file's own SHA256 plus this run's training_config SHA256 -- see FROZEN_GLOBS in that file
immutability_enforcement.honest_limitation: Like the existing sequestered-file 0400 permission bit (AUTONOMOUS_RESEARCH_READY.md SS9), chmod 444 on a file owned by the container's root user is a defense-in-depth control, not an absolute one -- a root process in the same container can still chmod it back and overwrite it. What actually prevents a mutated copy from being scored as if it were this baseline is the submission contract (task_card.md / benchmark/evaluation/_lib/submission.py): a candidate's own checkpoint must live under runs/ or workspace/, and this file's checkpoint_sha256 lets anyone re-verify the in-image file was never altered.

provenance_rules: This descriptor's own SHA256, and the reproduction run's training_config SHA256, are part of benchmark/integrity/frozen_manifest.json -- editing either without running verify_frozen.py --update is out of contract for the agent (it is a maintainer-only action, same as every other frozen-file update in this repo).

The checkpoint and compiled-checkpoint files themselves are NOT globbed into frozen_manifest.json (they are large binaries under data/mace_mof_0/runs/, outside FROZEN_GLOBS' path patterns) -- checkpoint_sha256/checkpoint_compiled_sha256 above are the durable record of their content; re-hash and compare before trusting a checkout that may have touched data/mace_mof_0/runs/.
benchmark/baselines/mace_mof0/manifest.json (mofs_v2, the published model) is unrelated and unchanged by this file.
